items.prompt: Edit the supplied game card artwork. Repaint ONLY the enormous burning eye and surrounding upper-background flames. No scales, detailed reptile skin, intricate iris fibers, photorealism, smooth airbrushing, decorative texture, extra particles or digital glow effects. No second eye, monster face, text, border or watermark.
